subtitle: Lesson 19 · IntegrationHub

code:
A niche internal inventory system, no official spoke.
Multiple flows keep asking: "does this item have stock?"

Task: design a reusable custom action,
"Check Inventory Level".
caption: One action, usable by any flow builder in the company.

steps.label: Input
steps.sub: Item SKU (string, required) — nothing else exposed to the consumer

steps.label: Endpoint + method
steps.sub: GET .../items/{sku}/availability on the inventory system's real API

steps.label: Authentication
steps.sub: a Chapter 3 Authentication Profile, referenced, never re-entered

code:
API response:
  { "sku": "...", "qty_available": 42, "warehouse": "DC-3" }

Action exposes only:
  Quantity Available (number) <- qty_available

warehouse and sku echo stay internal.
caption: Expose only what a consumer needs to act on.

steps.label: Clear naming
steps.sub: "Item SKU" and "Quantity Available" need no API knowledge to use

steps.label: Minimal Outputs
steps.sub: only the one field a consuming flow actually needs

steps.label: Shared credential
steps.sub: a service account, not a personal token that can break later
